name: Slacker
tagline: Cuts Slack down to the handful of messages that actually need you
description: Aimed at revenue and enablement leads who live in a loud workspace. Three times a day it sweeps the channels and hands you a short list of only the threads genuinely waiting on your answer, each one already paired with a reply you can send as-is. Silence means nothing needs you.
author: Scott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
